faq.answer: Direct flights are preferred when fare delta is less than $200 versus one-stop.

faq.scenario: Business trip extended for personal days
faq.answer: Only the business-portion airfare is reimbursable; comparison quote should be captured at booking.

rules.source_quote: Economy class is the default for all domestic and short-haul international flights.
Premium economy (or equivalent) is permitted on any single flight segment with a scheduled duration of 6 hours or more.
Business class is permitted only on international segments of 10+ hours with prior written VP approval; first class is not reimbursable.
Flights should be booked through Concur Travel whenever practical.
Flights should be booked at least 14 days in advance whenever the trip is planned that far ahead.
Last-minute bookings (under 7 days) require manager approval.
Employees should book the lowest reasonable fare consistent with business need.
First checked bag is reimbursable; second checked bag requires manager approval with business justification.
Standard seat selection is reimbursable; extra-legroom requires 4+ hour flight or documented accommodation.
Change/cancellation fees are reimbursable for documented business reasons, not personal preference.
In-flight Wi-Fi is reimbursable if used for business purposes.
Travel costs for spouses, family members, or other companions are never reimbursable.
For personal itinerary extensions, only business-portion airfare is reimbursable and comparison quote should be obtained at booking.
